IncidentDef.label: sealed nanite vault detected
IncidentDef.letterText: A precursor-era signal has resolved into something stranger than a power source. Sensors indicate an intact cryptosleep chamber containing a stable human-sized nanite lattice, but the body profile is that of a child. The site is old, sealed, and still defended by automated systems. This is a rare late-stage discovery: recovery is potentially transformative, but the occupant is a sovereign person rather than research material or a free production shortcut.
